description: The HR-53 RTO office is located in Adampur and functions under the Haryana Transport Department, primarily serving the Adampur sub-division of the Hisar district. It is headed by the Sub-Divisional Officer (Civil) who acts as the Registering Authority for motor vehicles and driving licenses in this region. This office plays a crucial role in managing vehicle registration and transport regulations for the rural and semi-urban areas surrounding Mandi Adampur.
address: Office of the SDO (Civil), Adampur, Hisar District, Haryana
